boundary_review.short: Broad right-edge band at +15s repeats; the first supporting source506 is still pending, finishes15.196. Later15.3s sheet fills most of this band. Remaining thin boundary difference unresolved. First-seen space is not a regression under motion-sheets.md.
boundary_review.tour: Broader ceiling hole repeats at source2350. Source-truth projection diagnostics find the marked ceiling pixels (40,50),(30,80),(80,50),(180,50) outside the previous60 admitted views. First-seen space, not a confirmed regression. No truth diagnostic was supplied to inference.
